calendarBasis: Current official 2026 championship calendar as of 2026-10-08
notes: The live 2026 championship calendar contains 23 rounds after in-season changes to the originally announced 24-round schedule.
Saudi Arabia is not present on the current 2026 calendar.
The Bahrain Grand Prix was relocated to Sepang International Circuit in Malaysia for 2-4 October 2026 and is represented as an event referencing the Sepang track entity.
Track ratings are game-design starting values informed by circuit characteristics; they are not official FIA or Formula 1 ratings.
High track-demand values mean that vehicle capability is more important at that circuit; they do not mean the track itself is 'better'.
Tyre Thermal Demand represents difficulty keeping tyres in their useful operating window, including both overheating and warm-up challenges.
Race characteristic ratings use 1 as low/easy and 5 as high/difficult.

trackDemandDefinitions.speed: Importance of straight-line speed and acceleration/deployment across the lap.
trackDemandDefinitions.cornering: Importance of aerodynamic cornering performance across the circuit's dominant corner types.
trackDemandDefinitions.mechanicalGrip: Importance of chassis/mechanical grip independent of pure aero load.
trackDemandDefinitions.tyres: Importance of tyre degradation control and keeping tyres in the operating window.
trackDemandDefinitions.accelerationDeployment: Importance of acceleration and effective energy deployment out of corners and along straights.
trackDemandDefinitions.highSpeedCornering: Importance of aero performance and stability in fast corners.
trackDemandDefinitions.lowSpeedCornering: Importance of rotation and low-speed aero/mechanical performance.
trackDemandDefinitions.braking: Importance of braking stability, efficiency and confidence.
trackDemandDefinitions.traction: Importance of traction on corner exit.
trackDemandDefinitions.tyreDegradation: How strongly preserving tyre performance across a stint matters.
trackDemandDefinitions.tyreThermalDemand: How challenging tyre temperature management is, whether through overheating or warm-up.

raceCharacteristicDefinitions.overtakingDifficulty: 1 = relatively easy to pass; 5 = track position and qualifying are critical.
raceCharacteristicDefinitions.pitLaneLoss: 1 = relatively cheap stop; 5 = very costly stop relative to a racing lap.
raceCharacteristicDefinitions.safetyCarRisk: 1 = low historical/structural likelihood; 5 = high incident and neutralisation potential.
raceCharacteristicDefinitions.mechanicalStress: 1 = relatively gentle; 5 = severe stress on brakes, power unit, cooling, kerbs or sustained loads.
raceCharacteristicDefinitions.weatherVolatility: 1 = generally stable; 5 = highly changeable or rain-sensitive.
raceCharacteristicDefinitions.trackEvolution: 1 = relatively stable surface; 5 = major grip evolution across the weekend.
